_comment: Canonical source for the settings matrix. One object per real user-facing/persisted setting. Rendered to SETTINGS_MATRIX.md by Scripts/generate-settings-matrix.py, which ALSO verifies this key set exactly matches the settings actually present in Sources/ (no orphaned or missing setting). Do not hand-edit SETTINGS_MATRIX.md.

settings.label: Menu bar item enabled
settings.effect: Inserts/removes the Core Bloom menu-bar item live.

settings.label: Onboarding completed
settings.effect: When false, the first-run onboarding is shown on launch; set true on completion.

settings.label: Onboarding step index
settings.effect: Persists progress through the onboarding wizard so it resumes at the same step.

settings.label: Dry run by default
settings.effect: Controls whether Cleanup and Smart Care start in dry-run (preview) mode instead of acting.

settings.label: Excluded paths
settings.effect: Paths the user has excluded are never included in cleanup/care findings.

settings.label: Security profile
settings.consumer: OnboardingView.swift (persists the first-run wizard profile choice)
settings.effect: Records which security profile the user picked at first run. Informational; the only live knob a profile sets is dryRunDefault.
